GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO1.title: Rank 1 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO1.description: After winning the battle, you will get Tao Xing. When 1 point of Taoism is accumulated, it will be upgraded to Rank 2 Aperture.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO1.flavor: Rank 1 Gu master Aperture, produces bronze true essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO2.title: Rank 2 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO2.description: In each battle, the first Gu worm lower than Rank 2 will be played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO2.flavor: Rank 2 Gu master Aperture, produces hematite true energy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO3.title: Rank 3 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO3.description: In each battle, the first Gu worm lower than Rank 3 will be played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO3.flavor: Rank 3 Gu master Aperture, produces silver true essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO4.title: Rank 4 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO4.description: In each battle, the first Gu worm lower than Rank 4 will be played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO4.flavor: Rank 4 Gu master Aperture, produces golden essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO5.title: Rank 5 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO5.description: In each battle, the first Gu worm lower than Rank 5 will be played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO5.flavor: Rank 5 Gu master Aperture produces amethyst true energy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO6.title: Rank 6 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO6.description: When obtained, Max HP increases by 6. At the beginning of each battle, add 1 Green Grape Immortal Essence to hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO6.flavor: Rank 6 Gu Immortal Immortal Aperture produces Green Grape Immortal Essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO7.title: Rank 7 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO7.description: When obtained, Max HP increases by 7. At the beginning of each battle, add 1 Red Date Immortal Essence to hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO7.flavor: Rank 7 Gu Immortal Immortal Aperture produces Red Date Immortal Essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO8.title: Rank 8 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO8.description: When obtained, Max HP increases by 8. At the beginning of each battle, add 1 White Litchi Immortal Essence to hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO8.flavor: Rank 8 Gu Immortal Immortal Aperture produces White Litchi Immortal Essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO9.title: Rank 9 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO9.description: When obtained, Max HP increases by 9. At the beginning of each battle, add 1 Yellow Apricot Immortal Essence to hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO9.flavor: "Everyone please remember that I, Gu Yue Fang Yuan, am the Great Love Immortal!"

GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_GU_CAN_HAI.title: Immortal Gu Remains
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_GU_CAN_HAI.descri: Your next forging at Rest Site does not Exhaust actions. {ExtraSmith} times remain.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_GU_CAN_HAI.flavor: The wreckage left after the destruction of Immortal Gu still retains some traces of the path.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LI_DAO_DAO_HEN.title: Strength Path Dao Mark
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LI_DAO_DAO_HEN.descrip: At the beginning of each battle, obtain Strength equal to the number of layers of Relic.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LI_DAO_DAO_HEN.flavor: The traces of Strength Path engraved on the Gu Master's body will turn into real Strength after accumulation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NI_LIU_HE.title: Reverse Flow River
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NI_LIU_HE.description: Reverse the next {Water} attack damage you receive to the attacker. Every time you advance one level, replenish 1 layer of Reverse Flow River water. Reverse Flow River water stores at most {MaxWater} layers.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NI_LIU_HE.flavor: Rule Path, the secret realm of heaven and earth, can counter all attacks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MIAN_CENG_XIANG_S: When the next {Battles} battle starts, give all enemies{FriendStacks} layer Friend. When the effect is exhausted or this Relic is right-clicked, it will be converted into a card and returned to your deck.
Transformation Path, the fairy-level Killer Move, comes from the Thieving Demon Lord.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TU_DUI_GU.title: Soil Mound Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TU_DUI_GU.description: You can keep up to 3 Block points across turns.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TU_DUI_GU.flavor: Rank 2Earth PathGu worm, which can generate mounds and solidify the defense.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_BI_GU_YI_GU.title: Arm Bone Wings Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_BI_GU_YI_GU.descriptio: In the first round of each battle, the first Attack card you played will be played one additional time.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_BI_GU_YI_GU.flavor: Rank 3Bone PathGu worm can grow a pair of bone wings on the forearm. By fanning the bone wings, the shooting speed can be increased.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MEI.title: Sword Eyebrows
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MEI.description: At the start of each combat, Gain 1 stack(s) of [gold]Sword Edge[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MEI.flavor: Able to imprint Sword Path Dao Mark in eyebrows.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LUO_PO_GU.title: Luo Po Valley
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LUO_PO_GU.description: At the start of each combat, Gain 1 stack(s) of [gold]Intangible[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LUO_PO_GU.flavor: The secret realm of Soul Dao Heaven and Earth is the first choice for soul refining.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GU_CI_GU.title: Bone Spike Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GU_CI_GU.description: At the start of each combat, Lose 1 HPandGain 4 stack(s) of [gold]Thorns[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GU_CI_GU.flavor: Rank 3Bone PathGu worm can cause the bones all over the body to mutate, producing sharp and hard Bone Spikes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TIE_GU_GU.title: Iron Bone Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TIE_GU_GU.description:
When picked up, 3 Max HP points are lost.
At the beginning of each battle, get 3 layers of [gold]Plated Armor[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TIE_GU_GU.flavor: Rank 3Bone PathGu worm can make the Gu Master's bones as hard as iron.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NONG_XU_GU.title: Fabrication Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NONG_XU_GU.description: At the beginning of each battle, add 1 random [gold]Phantom[/gold] card to hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NONG_XU_GU.flavor: The virtual Gu worm can fabricate Phantom out of thin air.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_YAN_XIN_GU.title: Flame Heart Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_YAN_XIN_GU.description: At the beginning of each round, add 1 [gold]Blaze[/gold] to hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_YAN_XIN_GU.flavor: Flame Heart Gu is placed in the heart and has the effect of enhancing fire-type Gu worm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NENG_LI_GU.title: Ability Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NENG_LI_GU.description: Whenever you play a Power card, you get 1 point of [gold]Strength[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NENG_LI_GU.flavor: Rank 8Strength PathImmortal Gu is recorded in "The Legend of Human Ancestors" and can continue to grow in Tribulation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHI_XIANG.title: Eat Fragrance
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHI_XIANG.description: When killing non-Minion's enemy, 1 point of HP is restored. The Food Path card's killing income is doubled.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHI_XIANG.flavor: Rank 6Food PathImmortal Gu, shaped like a wooden box and compact.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_LI_GU.title: Waste Effort Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_LI_GU.description: A enemy that owns a Strength loses 1 Strength point at the end of its turn.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_LI_GU.flavor: It can make every move of enemy waste more Effort and double the loss on Strength.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_GU_DUN_GU.title: Flying Bone Shield Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_GU_DUN_GU.descript: Offset the next non-HP loss damage suffered by {Uses}.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_GU_DUN_GU.flavor: Bone PathGu worm can fly out of the bone shield to resist external attacks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CUN_GUANG_YIN.title: Inch of Time
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CUN_GUANG_YIN.descript: When forging at Rest Site, upgrade 1 additional card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CUN_GUANG_YIN.flavor: Time flies, and it’s hard to buy Inch of Time with even a small amount of money.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_ROU_BAI_GU.title: Flesh on White Bone
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_ROU_BAI_GU.description: After losing HP in this battle, Recovery{Heal} points HP when the battle is won.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_ROU_BAI_GU.flavor: Flesh on White Bone, the living and the dead.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_MU_YA.title: Wood Sprout
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_MU_YA.description: Every time {Threshold} cards are Exhaustd, 1 Wood Path card is randomly added to hand and its energy consumption this round is 0. Current progress: {Counter}/{Threshold}.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_MU_YA.flavor: A Wood Path sprout that has just broken ground.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SI_XU_RU_DIAN_GU.title: Lightning Thought Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SI_XU_RU_DIAN_GU.descr: Whenever you get Thought, {Damage} points of damage will be caused to all enemies.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SI_XU_RU_DIAN_GU.flavo: Thoughts are like electricity, and Thought is about to move.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHUI_WEN_GU.title: Hydrology Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHUI_WEN_GU.descriptio: For every {Threshold} character accumulated in the name of the card you played, you will get {Gold}Gold.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHUI_WEN_GU.flavor: This is Hydrology Gu, withdraw quickly, we readers are most afraid of hydrology.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GOU_SHI_YUN.title: Dumb Luck
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GOU_SHI_YUN.descriptio: Among the battle rewards, {Chance}%Chance will drop an additional Relic.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GOU_SHI_YUN.flavor: One of the essences of Qi Luck True Tradition, which can significantly enhance Qi Luck.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_HONG_YUN_QI_TIAN_GU.de: The success rate of Chance cards is increased by {ProbabilityBonus} percentage points, and the rewards for rare cards are doubled by Chance.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_HONG_YUN_QI_TIAN_GU.fl: Good luck reaches the sky, and luck is like a rainbow.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FENG_XIONG_HUA_JI.desc: Whenever you get a curse card, turn it into a random card for your current character.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FENG_XIONG_HUA_JI.flav: Luck Path Gu that turns disaster into opportunity.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TOU_SHENG.title: Steal Life
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TOU_SHENG.description: Right-click during battle to steal all enemies{StealAmount} points and Max HP. {Uses} can also be used.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TOU_SHENG.flavor: Rank 8Theft PathImmortal Gu can steal the lifespan of all HP.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO10.title: Rank 10 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO10.descriptio: When obtained, Max HP is increased by 10 and HP is returned to full. When the battle starts, add 1 Yellow Apricot Immortal Essence to hand and obtain Eternal Life.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO10.flavor: The winding road is narrow and the world is narrow, and the life and death of Tribulation are complicated.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_DING_XIAN_YOU.title: Fixed Immortal Travel
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_DING_XIAN_YOU.descript: When selecting a room on the next level, you can ignore the current route.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_DING_XIAN_YOU.flavor: The legendary Yudao Immortal Gu recorded in "The Legend of Human Ancestors", the world is so big that there is nowhere it cannot go.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GUI_BU_JUE.title: Ghostly Concealment
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GUI_BU_JUE.description: The actions of the ghost class enemy cannot target you.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GUI_BU_JUE.flavor: Rank 9Theft PathKiller Move, which can protect against the perception of ghosts.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_CHI_GU.title: Perseverance Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_CHI_GU.descriptio: Keep each positive status you have once the first time it disappears due to its duration ending.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_CHI_GU.flavor: Persistence is not difficult, what is difficult is persisting to the end.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ANGRY_BIRD.desc: The upgraded Magma Burst Gu and any WillRank 6 to Rank 9Fire PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Angry Bird" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ANGRY_BIRD.flav: Fire PathKiller MoveGu recipe condenses the fiery Blaze into one blow.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_YANG_MANG_BEI_H: The upgraded Flame Armor Gu and any WillRank 6 or higherFire PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Verdant Sun Flame Cloak" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
The ultimate secret of Fire Path is to make your hair burn and turn into a huge flame cloak to protect your whole body.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ZHUI_MING_HUO.d: The upgraded Prairie Fire and any WillRank 6 or higherFire PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Life-Chasing Fire" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ZHUI_MING_HUO.f: Can sense the offensive, trace the source, and directly burn Immortal Aperture. As long as HP continues, this fire will continue to burn.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_XING_FEI_YI: The upgraded Star Thought Gu and any WillRank 6 or higherWisdom PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Myriad Star Fireflies" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
As soon as this move comes out, the sky and the earth are darkened, and night falls for thousands of miles around, every Thought thought by the Gu Immortal will form a star Thought.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XING_XIU_QI_PAN: Wisdom Gu and any WillRank 6 or higherWisdom PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Star Constellation Chessboard" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
The first Immortal Gu house in history has the world’s best Deduction capabilities.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_JIAN_LANG_SAN_D: The upgraded Wave Sword Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Sword PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Triple Sword Wave" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
One stack of sword waves is higher than the other, three waves in a row, and the power increases layer by layer.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_JIAN_MIAN_CENG_: The upgraded Attitude Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Transformation Path or Theft PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Familiar Face" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
Transformation Path, the fairy-level Killer Move, comes from the Thieving Demon Lord.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SAN_SHI_SAN_TIA: The upgraded River-Decline Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Light PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Thirty-Three Heavenly Lights" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
Light PathKiller Move, the more Radiance you accumulate, the more amazing the explosion will be.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SHANG_FANG_JIE_: The upgraded Rampage Gu and any WillRank 6 to Rank 9Strength PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Tear Off the Roof" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
It is extremely restrained from Defense-type states, and even strong Defense means can be forcibly broken.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SONG_YOU_FENG.d: The upgraded Eight-sided Majestic Gu can be Exhaustd at Rest Site with any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Wind Path or Theft PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Farewell Friend Wind". Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SONG_YOU_FENG.f: Wind PathKiller Move, give you a ride, and create Friend cause and effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_QI_SHA.title: Dark Fork AssassinationGu recipe
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_QI_SHA.descr: The upgraded Flying Sword Gu and Sword Shadow Gu, Multiple Sword Shadow Gu or Stacking Shadow Gu, Assemble Killer Move "Dark Fork Assassination" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_QI_SHA.flavo: The sword moves extremely fast, as fast as lightning.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_JIAN_HEN_SUO_MI: The upgraded Flying Sword Gu and any WillRank 6 to Rank 9Sword PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Sword Marks Claim Life" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
Sword Mark carves into the target's Weaknesses, claiming lives invisibly.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_WO.title: Myriad SelfGu recipe
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_WO.descript: The upgraded My Strength Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Strength PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Myriad Self" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_WO_DA_SHOU_: The upgraded Uproot Mountain Gu and any WillRank 6 or higherStrength PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Myriad Self Giant Hand" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
Gather the power of the crowd in one palm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WU_ZHI_QUAN_XIN: The upgraded Wisdom Sword Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Sword PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Five-Finger Fist-Heart Sword" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
After fifty-four tribulations, the clouds of tribulation still cover the sky.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XUE_JIAN_LENG.d: The upgraded Cold Blood Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Blood PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Blood Runs Cold" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XUE_JIAN_LENG.f: With Cold Blood Gu as the core, enemy's blood is quickly cooled until it freezes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XUE_PIAO_LIU.de: The upgraded Blood Rush Gu and any WillRank 6 to Rank 9Blood PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Blood Drift" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XUE_PIAO_LIU.fl: The long river of blood carries the user's Flight in the air, and a strong bloody atmosphere escapes wherever he goes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ZHU_MO_BANG.des: The upgraded Bloodline Gu and any WillRank 6 to Rank 9Blood PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Demon Judgment Board" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ZHU_MO_BANG.fla: The Rank 8Blood PathImmortal Gu house created by Tianting records the information of the five realms of magic and has almost no shortcomings.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_TIAN_PU_GUANG_H: The upgraded Great Light Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Light PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Heavenly Waterfall Light River" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
The river of light is rolling, the waves are tumbling, and every drop of the surging light water is like a fragment of the sun, dazzling to the extreme.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WU_JIN_XUAN_GUA: Five Restrictions Profound Light QiGu recipe

The upgraded Limit Gu and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Rule PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Five Restrictions Profound Light Qi" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
The mysterious light of the Five Forbiddens has been dim for two days, and Rank 8Killer Move has trapped the two deities.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_WU_DA_TONG_: The upgraded Adaptation and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Transformation Path or Strength PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Myriad Beings Assimilation Transformation" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
The supreme secret of Transformation Path can transform all things and make all things unified.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_GUANG_YIN_FEI_R: Blade Gu and any WillRank 6 to Rank 9Time PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Flying Time Blade" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
"When this blade comes out, there will be no miss, no miss, and no fatal blow."
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_BAI_GU_ZHAN_CHE: The upgraded Battle Bone Wheel and any WillRank 1 to Rank 9Bone PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "White Bone Chariot" can be Exhaustd at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace any Will material.
The number one Killer Move in the world is powerful, comparable to Rank 6Immortal Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_TU_ZHONG_SHA: Peaceful Earth Heavy Mountain FortressGu recipe
You can Exhaust 3 WillRank 1 to Rank 9Earth PathGu worm, Assemble Killer Move "Peaceful Earth Heavy Mountain Fortress" at Rest Site. Anti-Counterfeit Gu+ can replace one of the materials.
Rank 8Earth PathImmortal Gu house, Defense has the best capabilities of Rank 8.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHEN_BU_ZHI.title: Divine Concealment
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHEN_BU_ZHI.flavor: Rank 9Theft PathKiller Move can shield the detection of Will.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHUN_QIU_CHAN.title: Spring Autumn Cicada
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHUN_QIU_CHAN.descript: Right-click outside of combat to go back to an earlier time point. The backtracking failure rate is {FailChance}%, increasing by 10% after each use. Sleep the {Cooldown} layer after backtracking. {Snapshots} time nodes are currently saved.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHUN_QIU_CHAN.flavor: Spring Autumn Cicada maintains vitality with the water of the long river of time, and has the ability to rebirth people into the past.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.title: Rank Nine Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.flavor: Once the immortal fetus is formed, tribulations cannot touch it. At sovereign rank nine, myriad calamities cannot shake it.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.no_tribula: [gold]Sovereign immortal aperture. Tribulations are not required.[/gold]
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.preview_ef:
